# Training for a first marathon

Most of the training for a marathon is slow: easy runs build the body that the race asks for.

## The long run

Once a week, run longer than the week before, by ten percent at most. Every fourth week, run less, so the legs recover.

## Race day

Start slower than feels right. The second half decides the race, and the first half decides how the second one goes.
